theme: An open day with a single call at its center.
greeting: Morning, Dan. The calendar is nearly empty today — one Teams call at noon and otherwise clear, with the girls home this week in St. Pete. A good runway to close out the Croatia bookings that have been sitting.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night and transfer
needsAttention.detail: P1 on the Mike + Dan board, past due since Aug 26. It's the last night after the charter — book Cavtat on the airport side (refundable), plus the noon transfer from ACI Komolac. It has to be booked from dry land before the Sept 8 departure, and mid-September is still shoulder-peak on that coast.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: P1, past due since Aug 25. The issued Basic Economy ticket shows zero checked bags — confirm the allowance on the Eurowings Discover record and buy bags online now if they're not included, before airport-counter prices hit.

needsAttention.title: Fill the St Pete landing gap, Sept 20-21
needsAttention.detail: P1, past due since Aug 25 — two nights near St Pete after you land TPA and before the Tuesday kid pickup. Worth a glance too that the Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb converted from pending to confirmed.

flagged.title: OpenAI acknowledged your application
flagged.detail: Automated confirmation your application is in and will be reviewed for that role and similar ones.

flagged.title: New MyChart message from MaineHealth
flagged.detail: A message is waiting in your MaineHealth MyChart portal — sign in to read it.

flagged.title: Chase card statement is ready
flagged.detail: Statement balance $64.57, minimum $40, due Sept 22 — autopay is already on.

flagged.detail: Google logged OpenAI and Claude for Gmail being granted access, plus new sign-ins on Aug 25 — expected if that was you.

inbox.noise: The usual newsletters and receipts — New Yorker, NYT Cooking, Press Herald, a Paris receipt, and a couple of Todoist digests.

recipe.title: Chambery Trout
recipe.why: High summer is for quick, bright cooking, and a whole trout barely touched by heat lets the season's herbs and citrus do the work.

acts.line: A clear stretch until noon — the first genuinely open morning in a full week.
A single Teams call with Martin at midday, and the afternoon reopens once it's done.
Nothing on the calendar tonight — an evening at home with the girls in St. Pete.
